notes.title: (Mechanical Tower 2984) Playtest 1.11 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
New Content

Increase (boss) added "Arrow Shuttle" skill

Added controller vibration for protagonist's attacks, being hit, and component interactions

Optimizations

Player dodge speed now increases with movement speed

Optimized weapon selection display in the "Paradise" scene, now showing the currently equipped weapon type

Empowerment (boss) will now reclaim its summoned creatures after death

Bullets from the scatter shot skill of crossbow weapons will now penetrate enemies

Attack auto-lock will no longer target dead or non-attackable objects

Fixed an issue where players could pass through the next "door" without defeating all enemies

Crossbow attacks will now prevent enemies from moving after being hit

Fixed an issue with the description of the Command Rod

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where Chapter 2 background music could not loop

Fixed an issue where crossbows could kill enemies from a distance without activating combat

Fixed an issue where mouse-click attack direction could be inaccurate in some cases

📢 Feedback Channels

Community: QQ Group / Discord / X Official Account

🌟 To Players: Your feedback helps make Mechanical Tower 2984 better! We look forward to seeing you in the game!
